instruction: Fill all blank cells in the range B2:E15 with the value from the cell directly above it. Complete the task without modifying any cells outside this range.

metadata.explanation: Variation 0 focuses on filling a partial range (rows 2-15) instead of the full range. This tests the agent's ability to restrict operations to a specified range. Expected values verified by simulating fill-down logic: B3='Primary' (filled from B2), C3='Blake Dreary' (filled from C2), B8='Secondary' (filled from B7), etc. Sample of 10 key cells checked for correctness.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Metric checks ALL 56 cells in range B2:E15 are filled (no None values remain)
Fill-down logic correctly verified: Metric verifies that each cell contains the value from the cell directly above it by checking consecutive rows in each column
Sample validation provides sanity check: 10 expected cells validate that specific positions have correct values
Getter correctly extracts the full range B2:E15 (rows 2-15, columns B-E)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('filled_cells', {}) without incorrect nesting
Expected values are semantically correct (e.g., B3='Primary' filled from B2, C8='Arnold Shawarma' filled from C7)
